audience: teams who send text and voice broadcasts to their contacts with Text-Em-All

useCases.title: Review recent broadcasts and their results
useCases.text: Lists broadcasts, text and voice, filtered by status, and opens one to read its status and summary.

useCases.title: Check who a broadcast reached
useCases.text: Reads the per-contact delivery details of a broadcast, with who was reached and the delivery status of each.

useCases.title: Check our credit balance and account settings
useCases.text: Reads the account settings, including company and billing information and the credit balances used for sending.

useCases.title: See our contact lists and text numbers
useCases.text: Lists the saved contact lists you can broadcast to and the text (SMS) numbers on the account.

useCases.title: Send a broadcast or stage a draft
useCases.text: Sends a text or voice broadcast to the contacts you give. Or it stages a draft and returns a link to finish and send it in Text-Em-All.

useCases.title: Send a one-to-one text to a contact
useCases.text: Finds your text numbers, then sends a conversation text from one of them to a single contact.
